domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India sales split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and the web_search tool was non-functional during this run (connection refused), so no domestic-supply record was seen. Import side is documented on the same ImportKey page (e.g. "2026-02-23 TURNSTONE INTERNATIONAL PTE LTD -> TEX YEAR INDUSTRIAL ADHESIVES PRIVATE LIMITED ... 39023000 | BOL 7690651"; "2026-02-14 USI CORPORATION -> ... 39013000 | BOL 7522529"), which proves an operating Indian plant consuming adhesive raw materials, but that is not a domestic sales record.
note: Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code (UAE Jebel Ali x2, Nigeria Apapa, plus a Nepal buyer), so this is not a website claim. Declared HS 350699 vs actual observed export HS 35069190 — same 6-digit heading 3506, subheading differs (3506.91 = adhesives based on rubber/plastics); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, HS should be corrected to the factual 35069190. Company is a manufacturer-type operation (imports EVA/propylene copolymer resins and exports hot-melt adhesive), not a pure trader. Domestic supply status left as unknown rather than none_found because the registries needed to check GST/GeM were blocked (403) and search was down — absence of evidence here is a tooling gap, not proof of no domestic sales. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in the free view.
